point: rn's product-vision template requires two key results for each objective, how well and how fast, and at least one idea under the concept, so overnight's vision can't keep only its vital few as you decided: one key result for each objective (the share of tasks that don't reach their full result), and a concept of the one sentence "overnight keeps AI agents working while the user sleeps." Should rn change the template so that a vision may drop a key result that isn't vital and may hold its concept as the one sentence alone, or should overnight's vision keep the how-fast key results (the commands the arranging AI runs, the lines the calling plugin's AI writes) and some ideas under the concept? I recommend changing the template, as its fixed counts push every vision toward the trivial many that you sent this one back for.
